topic: VSSM regular barrel GS ADS tier versus WB timing effects

build.xmlOverlayCaveat: VSSM attachment selector metadata (AD_VSSM_BRL_Barrel.xml and AD_VSSM_BRL_ASM.xml) is listed stale; conclusions below rely on non-stale asset source records and descriptor-decoded raw capture.

gsRoute.claim: The VSSM GS binds GID_ADSTime_BRL_P10 to the regular/basic barrel selector identity. The modifier encodes +1 in both integer values, supporting a source-level +1 GS ADS tier.

gsRoute.scopeLimit: GS binding and encoded tier only; native consumption and final transition timing remain unresolved. GS containing layouts carry the conservative decoder warning.

wbRoute.claim: VSSM_WB exposes a distinct animation/FOV timing route. The two barrel package effects contain spotting/suppressed-audio entries only; neither contains a WME_ADSTime_Anim_P10 nor WME_ADSTime_FOV_P10 entry. Therefore the existing WB barrel ADS generator resolves no barrel contribution and assigns 0 for both VSSM barrels. This does not cancel, compose with, or disprove the GS tier.

weaponBlueprint.barrelPackages: Class_542ac52c raw object index9 / Field_0cd9f20f[72] imports WPM_BRL_VSSMBasic_W10 object 1e7e87f2-dd0e-49db-917f-dec1e59629bd; [73] imports WPM_BRL_VSSMNoPort_W10 object 347b523f-7058-4198-8cf6-004ce433c903.

wbRoute.timingConsumerDistinction: WB WME_ADSTime_Anim_P10 and WME_ADSTime_FOV_P10 target separate animation-transition and field-of-view ADS timing channels, counted as parallel evidence and not added together by the Analyzer. GS GID_ADSTime_BRL_P10 is a distinct weapon-stat/index binding. Numeric equality across all three +1 tier names does not establish a shared native consumer or additive total.

analyzerProposal.recommendation: Keep the current WB-derived barrel ADS value at 0 for both VSSM barrels. Preserve the GS +1 as a separate, explicitly labeled source-backed tier/coordinate. Do not add GS +1 to the WB ADS milliseconds or present it as confirmed extra delay.
analyzerProposal.remainingBlocker: Native consumption of the GS tier or controlled VSSM ADS timing with factory optic and fixed magazine; compare regular and ASM barrels. Neither is available in this source-only pass.
